notes: [stonewithdraw-01, WITHDRAW BEFORE DIG (design docs/reports/ziggurat-mineshaft-2026-10-15.md 5.1) + goto dig-retry evidence (5.2 step 1), on base b7cc60b5. NOT QUEUED: the operator queues it.] THE DEFECT (15 h full walk 10-14 11:30Z..10-15 02:30Z, 80 bots): gather stone is 9.2% of the fleet's 45.5k cobble/day; 94% of stone gathers start below the 64 reserve while 8 of 12 shared towns sit at the 256 cobble cap and refuse deposits. THE CHANGE: an ADMITTED stone gather (stone/cobblestone/cobbled_deepslate/deepslate) is rewritten deterministically to `withdraw cobblestone <n>` (alt cobbled_deepslate, from = the fresh-counted town container holding n) when the bot is within Chebyshev 48 of home, at the surface (y >= home.y-8), not on a stuck trigger, the town's fresh cobble floor >= n+64, and neither the admission memory nor the rewrite's own 10-min backoff refuses it; otherwise the gather runs exactly as today. One _stone_withdraw row per stone-gather decision. A rewrite neither records wins nor failures in the lessons store; the repeat window holds the action run. goto_dig_retry rows gain walk_status/walk_visited/walk_len/bag_cobble/retry_dig_attempts (telemetry only). EXPECTED CUT ~0.2-0.75k cobble/day shared (small; cheap; drains refused chests). KNOWN GAPS (reviews): the stockpile rung's own order (5.1a) and mine losing rung credit within 48 are NOT built; the withdraw count is the model's count (may churn against the bank); two bots can pass the 64 floor together (advisory floor). PAPER sandbox4: surface (withdraw 16, chest -16 net of the base's withdraw_pick, 0 stone dug), short (town_short -> gather dug 16), deepslate (alt taken), retry (args present, walk noPath). REVIEWS: Codex r1 CHANGE, r2 APPROVE, r3 see file; Claude r1 CHANGE, r2 APPROVE, r3 see file (docs/reports/stonewithdraw-01-reviews-2026-10-15.txt).

licence.note: Only this build writes _stone_withdraw (one row per stone-gather decision); the base has no such row.

draw_exposure.note: Every shared pool gathers stone near town (~0.5-0.8 stone gathers per bot-h); 8 of 12 towns hold >= 248 cobble.

exposure.note: Ready = >= 10 rewrites whose withdraw was matched, in a window >= 150 min.

own_lines.note: W1: a rewrite more than 48 (Chebyshev) from home, judged on the row's own d.
W2: a rewrite on a stuck trigger.
W3: a rewrite below home.y-8 (the rule rewrites at the surface only).
W4: >= 10 rewrites and > 50% of their matched withdraws failed or were unknown (rewriting into failure).
W4's positive control: the matcher found < 80% of the rewrites' withdraws. Blocks KEEP (no evidence key).
Leak: a CONTROL _stone_withdraw row. Blocks KEEP (no evidence key).

primary.note: REPORTED: stone-gather cobble per bot-h within 48 of home, DiD (expected to fall); cobble withdrawals DiD (expected to rise); mine cobble DiD; milestones completed and craft successes DiD (the design's 'must not fall', rate-class: report-only); the decision mix by reason; goto dig retries by walk_status.

harm.note: Unchanged: the two-death floor (OWNER 2026-09-11) and gather_ratio < 0.43 of control (scripts/canary-report.py).

teardown.note: THREE STEPS: drop-ins, clear canary_pool, restart the pool's bots 12 s apart; then confirm the live versions. The change writes no persistent state (the backoff is in memory; the lessons store is never written by a rewrite).

extension.note: SHORT CANARY for a fix-class change: the deterministic defect gates decide.
